title: 降息预期被泼冷水：只差一个坏数据，就扣加息扳机？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Bill Dutta of Renmax standing by it. Ready to jump into the conversation, Neil?
segments.zh: Renmax的Bill Dutta在等待。Neil，准备好加入对话了吗？

segments.en: Is the October rate hike on life support or not? How do you see things looking at this data and the data over the last week?
segments.zh: 10月加息还有戏吗？结合当前数据和上周数据，你怎么看？

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, I could say that it's on life support, but to the point that she made earlier, which is one that I agree with, I mean, you still, I think, are really just one more
segments.zh: 可以说还有戏，但就像她之前说的，我也同意，我认为真的只差一个

segments.en: bad inflation number away from them pulling the trigger on a hike.
segments.zh: 糟糕的通胀数据，他们就会扣动加息的扳机。

segments.en: I mean, if you think about going into next year, the Fed sees core inflation cooling to 2.5% in 2027
segments.zh: 展望明年，美联储预计核心通胀到2027年将降温至2.5%，

segments.en: on a Q4 over Q4 basis. And think about what we've seen in the first quarter
segments.zh: 按四季度同比计算。想想我们每年一季度看到的情况，

segments.en: of every year going back to 2023.
You know, core inflation over that first quarter runs close to 4% at an annual rate.
segments.zh: 一季度核心通胀年化率接近4%。

segments.en: So the odds are, I think, that the Fed has to revise up its inflation forecast in the first quarter of next year.
segments.zh: 所以我认为，美联储很可能不得不在明年一季度上调通胀预测。

segments.en: I mean, if they don't do it in December, it'll probably be by March.
segments.zh: 如果12月不调，那可能最晚3月就会调。

segments.en: And so, you know, that's why I'm a little bit reluctant to kind of buy into the Dovish thesis wholesale.
segments.zh: 所以，这就是为什么我不太愿意全盘接受鸽派观点。

segments.en: You know, it's true that unit labor costs have been low and we continue to see very weak wage pressure.
segments.zh: 确实，单位劳动力成本一直较低，工资压力也持续疲弱。

segments.en: And that's welcome for the Dov's because it gives the Fed time to move again.
segments.zh: 这对鸽派来说是好消息，因为给了美联储再次行动的时间。
